**Note**: This script is provided for reference to show the data processing workflow. It requires specific raw Excel files that are not included in this public repository. Users wishing to adapt the model should ensure their input data matches the formatting seen in the /data/processed/ folder.

```{r, setup-file, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
# Set global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,      # Show code chunks by default
  message = FALSE,  # Hide messages globally
  warning = FALSE,  # Hide warnings globally
  results = 'asis'
  # fig.width = 8,    # Set default figure width
  # fig.height = 5    # Set default figure height
)

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman"); library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)
if (!dir.exists("data/processed")) {dir.create("data/processed", showWarnings = FALSE)}

# Add ggplot theme to use ----
theme_baseR <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Remove minor grid lines
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"), # Ensure white background and add a border
    strip.background = element_blank() # Remove background from facet labels if applicable
  )
```

# 1. Climatic Data

```{r, clim}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Format Forcing Variables -- Precipitation and Et0 ---
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
clim <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/raw/Model in Excel/2 WB_Anantapur_Crop_Level.xlsx", sheet = "Climate")

precip <- clim %>% 
  select(date = Date, p = `Rainfall (mm)`) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date), p = as.numeric(p))

knitr::kable(head(precip[1:3,]))

write.csv(precip, file = "data/processed/01_precipitation.csv", row.names = FALSE)

et0.daily <- clim %>% 
  select(date = Date, et0 = ET0) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date), et0 = as.numeric(et0))

knitr::kable(head(et0.daily[1:3,]))

write.csv(et0.daily, file = "data/processed/02_et0.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# For creating fig
climate_summary <- clim %>% 
  select(date = Date, p = `Rainfall (mm)`, temp = `Moy Temp`, et0 = ET0) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date), p = as.numeric(p), temp = as.numeric(temp), et0 = as.numeric(et0), Year = format(date, "%YY"), Month = format(date, "%m")) %>%
 # 2. Group the data by these time periods
  group_by(Year, Month) %>%
  # 3. Apply mean to temperatures and sum to rain/evapotranspiration
  summarise(
    Temperature   = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Rainfall      = sum(p, na.rm = TRUE),
    ET0           = sum(et0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Take climatogical mean
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric), 
      .fns = list(
        avg  = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        q05  = ~ quantile(.x, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        q95  = ~ quantile(.x, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}" # Dynamically renames columns (e.g., Rainfall_avg, Rainfall_q05)
    )
  )
write.csv(climate_summary, file = "data/processed/03_climatology_for_figure.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# 3. Crop Parameters 

## 3.1 Rooting Depth, Irrigation

```{r, crop-param}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# SAVE Crop Parameters (rooting depth, irrigation)----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
crop.param <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/raw/Model in Excel/2 WB_Anantapur_Crop_Level.xlsx",
                            sheet = "CROP parameters")

crop.param <- crop.param[, !as.logical(sapply(crop.param, function(x)all(is.na(x))))]
crop.param <- crop.param %>% 
  filter(!if_all(everything(), is.na)) %>% 
  filter(!if_all(2:4, is.na)) %>%
  select(-Ref)
# > colnames(crop.param)
# [1] "CROP"               "irrig =1 rainfed=2" "rooting depth (cm)"
colnames(crop.param) <- c("crop", "irrigation", "rooting_depth_cm")
crop.param <- crop.param %>%
  mutate(crop = str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", crop, perl = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(irrigation = case_match(as.character(irrigation), "1" ~ "irrigated", "2" ~ "rainfed", .default = NA)) %>%
  mutate(crop.ID = match(crop, unique(crop))) %>%
  select(crop.ID, everything())
write.csv(crop.param, file = "data/processed/05_crop.parameters.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# 4. Crop Systems by Rotations

```{r, crop-systems}

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# SAVE Crop Systems by Rotations ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

## For More info, see "communications/Understanding Data in Excel Sheet_Crop.Systems.pdf"

# 1. “Groundnut/Tomato/Tomato/Fallow”: avg of “Groundnut/Tomato” and “Tomato/Fallow”; 
# 2. "Groundnut/Okra/Okra/Fallow": avg of “Okra/Tomato” and “Okra/Fallow”; 
# 3. BWP of Grassland grazed once is the average BWP of “WB grazed_1 Aug, 1 Sept, 1
#      Oct, and 1 Nov”, as we considered different rotations where grazing occurs once
#      during the rainy season 
# 4. Rice/Banana is the average of WB Rice_Banana 1, WB Banana 1, and WB Banana 2 (3-
#      year crop cycle)
# 5. The same applies to Napier: rice/Napier in the first year, followed by Napier
#      continuing to grow in the second year (2-year crop cycle)

crop.systems <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/raw/Model in Excel/2 WB_Anantapur_Crop_Level.xlsx", sheet = "All rotations")
# Removing dummy rotation 'Sauvegarde'
crop.systems <- as.data.frame(t(crop.systems[c(1:4), -c(1, 2)]))
names(crop.systems) <- c("crop1_crop2_crop3", "crop.system", "n.rotation", "soil")
crop.systems <- crop.systems %>%
  mutate(WB = row.names(crop.systems)) %>%
  subset(!is.na(n.rotation)) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(WB, delim = " ", names = c(NA, "rotation"), 
                       too_many = "merge", cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(crop.system = str_to_title(crop.system),
           rotation = str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", rotation, perl = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(crop.system.ID = match(crop.system, unique(crop.system)),
         rotation.ID = match(rotation, unique(rotation))) %>%
  mutate(crop1_crop2_crop3 = str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", crop1_crop2_crop3, perl = TRUE))) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(crop1_crop2_crop3, "-", 
                       names = c("crop_1", "crop_2", "crop_3"),
                       cols_remove = FALSE, too_few = "align_start") %>%
  select(crop.system.ID, crop.system, n.rotation, rotation, rotation.ID, soil, crop1_crop2_crop3, WB, everything()) %>%
  relocate(crop1_crop2_crop3, .after = crop_3) %>%
  relocate(WB, .after = last_col())

knitr::kable(head(select(crop.systems, -crop1_crop2_crop3, -WB)))

# Save All Rotations output for Comparison with R output
all.rotations <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/raw/Model in Excel/2 WB_Anantapur_Crop_Level.xlsx", sheet = "All rotations")
# Removing dummy rotation 'Sauvegarde'
all.rotations <- as.data.frame(all.rotations[1:30,])
excel.result <- all.rotations[-c(1:6),]

names(excel.result)[1] <- "var"; 
names(excel.result)[2] <- "stat"

excel.result$stat[is.na(excel.result$stat)] <- "mean"
excel.result <- excel.result %>%
  filter(if_any(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  mutate(var.std = lag(var, n = 1)) %>%
  relocate(var.std, .after = var) %>%
  mutate(var = if_else(is.na(var), var.std, var)) %>% 
  select(-var.std) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(1,2), function(x) {round(as.numeric(x))}))
write.csv(excel.result, file = "data/processed/00_excel.result_sheet_All_Rotations.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## 4.1 Join Crop Rooting Depth & Irrigation Requirement. SAVE Individual Crop (and Parameters) in a given Crop System by Row

```{r, join-crop-root-depth}
crop.systems.l <- crop.systems %>%
  select(-WB) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("crop_"),
               names_prefix = "crop_",
               names_to = "ncrop", values_to = "crop")

#_________________
# Join Crop Parameters (rooting depth, Irrigation, Crop.ID) ----
#_________________

crop.param <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/05_crop.parameters.csv", header = TRUE)
knitr::kable(head(crop.param))

crop.systems.l <- crop.systems.l %>%
  left_join(crop.param, by = "crop") %>%
  relocate(crop.ID, .after = crop)

root.crop.matches <- match(crop.systems.l$crop, crop.param$crop)
if (!any(is.na(root.crop.matches))) {
  print("Crop root parameters present for crops in all rotations.")
} else {
  print("Crop root parameters not present for crops:");
  print(crop.systems.l$crop[is.na(root.crop.matches)])
}
# Adding crop by rotation ID
crop.systems.l <- crop.systems.l %>%
  mutate(crop.rotation.ID = paste0(crop, ".", rotation.ID))
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# SAVE Individual Crop (and Parameters) in a given Crop System by Row ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
knitr::kable(head(crop.systems.l))

write.csv(crop.systems.l, file = "data/processed/07_crop.systems.l.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## Add, if Crop System is irrigated, if any of the crop is irrigated
cs.rot.irri <- crop.systems.l %>%
  mutate(Irrigation = if_else(irrigation == "irrigated", TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(crop.system, rotation) %>%
  summarise(Irrigation = any(Irrigation), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Irrigation = if_else(Irrigation == TRUE, "Irrigated", "Rainfed"))

crop.systems <- crop.systems %>% left_join(cs.rot.irri, by = c("crop.system", "rotation")) %>% 
  relocate(Irrigation, .after = crop.system)
write.csv(crop.systems, file = "data/processed/08_crop.systems.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## 4.2 Join Crop Kc Curves for each Crop System Rotation

```{r, read-kc-curves}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# READ Crop Kc Curves ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
kc.doy <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/06_Crop_Kc_by_DOY_all_crops.csv", header = TRUE)

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Verify if Kc curves present for all crops----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

crop.all <- unique(crop.systems.l$crop[crop.systems.l$crop != "No_crop"])
kc.crop.matches <- match(crop.all, unique(kc.doy$crop))
if (!any(is.na(kc.crop.matches))) {
  print("Kc curve present for crops in all rotations.")
} else {
  print("Kc curve not present for these crops:")
  print(crop.all[is.na(kc.crop.matches)])
}

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# JOIN Crop Kc Curves by Crop Rotation ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  
crop.systems.l.kc <- crop.systems.l %>% select(rotation.ID, rotation, crop.rotation.ID, crop.system.ID, crop.system, soil, ncrop, crop, crop.ID, irrigation, rooting_depth_cm) %>%
  left_join(kc.doy %>% arrange(doy, crop), by = "crop", relationship = "many-to-many")

knitr::kable(head(crop.systems.l.kc))
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# SAVE list: Crop Rotation data with soil, Crop root, irri and Kc curves for the water budget function ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
crop.rotation.kc.ls <- split(crop.systems.l.kc, crop.systems.l.kc$rotation)

save(crop.rotation.kc.ls, file = "data/processed/09_crop.rotation.kc.ls.Rdata")
```

### 4.2.1 Plot Crop Kc Curves by Rotation - one pager

```{r, kc-curves-by_rotation, fig.show="hold", out.width="100%", eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.cap='Kc curves by Crop System Rotations', include=TRUE}

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# PLOT Crop Kc Curves by Rotation - one pager ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

p.crop.systems.l.kc <- ggplot(subset(crop.systems.l.kc, crop != "No Crop"), 
                           aes(x = doy, y = kc)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = crop, group = ncrop), show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(. ~ rotation) +
    theme_baseR +
  ylab("Crop Coefficient (Kc)") + xlab("Day of Year")
print(p.crop.systems.l.kc)
ggsave(plot = p.crop.systems.l.kc, file = paste0("figures/crop_kc_curves/Crop_Coefficient_Curves_by_rotation.jpg"), width = 7, height = 5)
```

### 4.2.2 Plot Crop Kc Curves Crop System per page by Rotation

```{r, kc-curves-by-system-per-page, fig.show=FALSE, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# PLOT Kc Curves by Crop System per page by Rotation ----
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
crop.systems.kc.ls <- split(crop.systems.l.kc, crop.systems.l.kc$crop.system)

all.kc.figure.file <- "figures/crop_kc_curves/Crop_System_Kc_Curves_by_Rotation.pdf"
plot.pdf <- function (x) {
  pdf(all.kc.figure.file, width = 6, height = 4)
    invisible(lapply(names(crop.systems.kc.ls), function(crop.system) {
  df <- crop.systems.kc.ls[[crop.system]]
  p <- ggplot(subset(df, crop != "No Crop"),
         aes(x = doy, y = kc)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = crop, group = ncrop)) +
    facet_grid(rotation ~ .) +
    theme_baseR + ylab("Crop Coefficient (Kc)") + xlab("Day of Year") +
    ggtitle(crop.system) + theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(p)
  }))
invisible(dev.off())
}
plot.pdf()
```

# 5. Production System Composition: Crop Systems by Area

```{r}
# This provides the area of each crop system typically cultivated under each Type of Farm, or Production System
ps_area <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/raw/Model in Excel/For Rutuja_Crop_System_Area_by_Production_System.xlsx", sheet = "Farm Type structure")

# List of curated crop.system & WB columns to replace the Cropping System column
crop.systems <- read.csv(file = "data/processed/08_crop.systems.csv", header = TRUE)

ps_area <- ps_area %>%
  subset(!is.na(WB)) %>%
  full_join(crop.systems %>% select(crop.system, WB), by = "WB") %>% relocate(crop.system, .before = 1) 

# WB without crop.system
ps_area[is.na(ps_area$crop.system), c("crop.system", "WB")]
# crop.system not yet assigned
ps_area[is.na(ps_area$`Cropping system`), c("crop.system", "WB")]

ps_area <- ps_area %>%
  mutate(crop.system = 
           if_else(WB == "WB Rice/Banana", "Rice/Banana",
                   if_else(WB == "WB Grazed_Once", "Grasslands (Grazed Once)",
                           if_else(WB == "WB Rice/Napier", "Rice/Napier", 
                                   crop.system))))
# Unused crop.system: 
remaining.cs <- ps_area[is.na(ps_area$`Cropping system`), c("crop.system", "WB")]
ps_area <- ps_area %>%
  subset(!is.na(`Cropping system`)) 
# Workbooks unused, or with no corresponding area
remaining.cs <- remaining.cs %>% subset(!crop.system %in% ha$crop.system)
#   crop.system         WB                    
#   <chr>               <chr>                 
# 1 Grasslands          WB Grasslands         
# 2 Rice/Rice           WB Rice_Rice          
# 3 Rice/Groundnut      WB Rice_Groundnut     
# 4 Groundnut/Groundnut WB Groundnut_Groundnut

ps_area_cleaned <- ps_area %>%
  subset(!is.na(`Cropping system`)) %>%
  select(-`Cropping system`, -WB) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -crop.system, names_to = "Production System", values_to = "Area_ha") %>%
  subset(!is.na(Area_ha) & !Area_ha == 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Extract the digits inside the parentheses (e.g., 1950s)
    Period = str_extract(`Production System`, "(?<=\\()\\d{4}s?(?=\\))"),
    
    # 2. Strip the trailing space and parenthetical part from the original column
    `Production System` = str_remove(`Production System`, "\\s*\\(\\d{4}s?\\)$")
  ) %>% 
  select(`Production System`, Period, crop.system, Area_ha) %>% arrange(`Production System`, Period)

write.csv(ps_area_cleaned, file = "data/processed/Crop_System_Area_By_Production_System.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
